Shaft wept, so I fitted a [[part]]brass gland[[/]], a [[part]]ceramic seal[[/]] and a [[part]]start capacitor[[/]]. Slip gross is [[gross]]2,460.80[[/]] rupees and the dairy lad already passed me [[paid]]315.25[[/]], not netted on this sheet. Opened [[opened]]3 March 2026[[/]]. Hold is [[hold]]18[[/]] days from that morning. Copied the bench scribble dated [[noted]]9 April 2026[[/]]. Packing-seal code never got written. Night chop landed sideways. thoda tel gela along the coupl
ing, I wiped it and signed.
